Breastfeeding journey is always full of surprises. That's why we
made
Pump and Know
A new series with short, science-backed tips.
Keep learning, keep breastfeeding better, keep discovering
surprises.
Did you know breastfeeding can help with weight loss...and
even lower your risk of cancer?
• Burn Baby Fat
Breastfeeding can torch 400-500 calories a day-basically like
a power walk... while feeding your baby.
• Natural Cancer Shield
Every 12 months of breastfeeding can lower your risk of breast
and ovarian cancer.
• Bonus: Natural Contraceptive
Exclusively breastfeeding and no period? Your chance of
getting pregnant in the first 6 months postpartum drops to
under 2%.
